Theme

Latin word

longus

longus, longa, longum

adjective · Declension on Wiktionary

long-lasting; long; long (of a vowel or syllable); of a person: long-winded, tedious

In this lexicon

  • chronic

    also used · classical · Traupman 63; Traupman 291

  • long

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 21.28.7: ducentōs longam pedēs; Cic. Att. 16.11: longissima epistula (Lewis & Short); Traupman 204; Traupman 341

  • long

    the recommended word · classical · Quint. 9.4.47: ūna enim syllaba longa pār est duābus brevibus; Quint. 1.7.3; Traupman 247

  • long-winded

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. N.D. 1.36.101: nōlō esse longus, I don’t want to be long-winded (Lewis & Short); Traupman 341

  • nē longus sim: to make a long story short

    modern
